📢 Assistant Professor Vacancy – B.Ed. Programme, Goa

Goa Vidyaprasarak Mandal’s Dr. Dada Vaidya College of Education, Ponda, Goa is inviting applications from Indian citizens for the post of:

👨‍🏫 Assistant Professor in Education (Methodology of Teaching Hindi)
📌 1 Post | Contract Basis | Unreserved

🎓 Eligibility:
• Master’s Degree with 50% marks
• M.Ed. with at least 55% marks
• NET/SET qualified candidates preferred
• Ph.D. candidates as per UGC norms may be exempted from NET/SET
• Knowledge of Konkani is essential; Marathi is desirable

📍 Location: Ponda, Goa
📅 Applications to be submitted within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

For complete qualifications, requirements and application details, visit www.gvmcollege.edu.in
💬 Comment “EDUCATION” if you are going to apply for this role.
